                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/cyh1130/p/19816568" title="发布于 2026-04-03 12:42">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">JetBrains 发布全新 AI IDE：AIR，会不会改变开发方式？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="nice" data-tool="mdnice编辑器" data-website="https://www.mdnice.com" style="margin: 0; padding: 0 10px; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; font-family: PingFangSC-regular, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; word-spacing: 0; letter-spacing: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; text-align: left"><p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">当“AI 辅助编程”从一个可选功能，变成开发工具的核心逻辑，IDE 会变成什么样？</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">最近 JetBrains 推出的 AIR（AI IDE），给出了一个比较激进的答案：不是在 IDE 里加 AI，而是让 AI 成为 IDE 的基础能力。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这篇文章结合实际开发体验和一些思考，聊一聊 AIR 到底是什么，它解决了什么问题，以及对我们意味着什么。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">官网：
https://air.dev/</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">文档：
https://www.jetbrains.com/help/air/getting-started.html</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">一、AIR 是什么？</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">简单来说，AIR 是一个“以 AI 为核心工作流”的开发环境。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">和我们熟悉的工具不太一样，比如 Copilot、Cursor，本质上还是在帮你写代码、补全代码。而 AIR 的思路是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你负责描述任务，AI 负责完成任务。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这里的变化其实很关键——从“写代码”，变成“定义问题”。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AIR 的几个核心特点：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">AI 是默认流程，而不是附加功能</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">所有改动都可以被审查（不是黑箱）</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">开发者始终拥有最终控制权</section></li></ul>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">二、开发流程发生了什么变化？</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果用一句话总结：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">过去是“人写代码”，现在更像是“人指挥 AI 写代码”。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">一个完整流程大概是这样的：</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">1. 定义任务</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你不再是从写函数开始，而是先描述需求，比如：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">给订单模块增加分页查询功能，每页 10 条，参考已有 service 层实现。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你还可以补充：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">指定文件或目录</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">引用已有代码</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">限制修改范围</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AI 会先生成一个执行计划，然后再逐步实现。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">2. 执行任务</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AI 会自动完成一系列操作：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">阅读项目结构</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">分析依赖关系</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">修改多个文件</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">必要时执行代码</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">过程中你可以随时打断、补充说明，或者调整方向。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">3. 审查结果</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这是 AIR 设计里非常重要的一步。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">所有 AI 的修改都会以差异（diff）的形式展示出来，你可以：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">查看每一处修改</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">逐行评论</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">决定是否接受</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这一步的意义在于，把“控制权”重新交还给开发者。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">三、几个比较有意思的点</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">结合目前的信息，有几个地方值得注意。</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">1. 多任务并行</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">可以同时运行多个任务，比如：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">一个任务写测试</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">一个任务修 Bug</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">一个任务优化代码</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">互不影响。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这种模式在复杂项目里可能会有价值，尤其是一些重复性工作。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">2. 权限控制</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AIR 提供不同的执行权限，比如：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">只分析，不修改</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">修改前询问</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">自动修改</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">完全开放</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这其实是在解决一个现实问题：AI 能不能随便动你的代码。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这个设计更偏向工程化，而不是单纯的“好用”。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">3. MCP 扩展</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">通过 MCP（Model Context Protocol），可以把 AI 接到外部系统，比如：</p>

<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这意味着 AI 不只是写代码，还可能参与到整个业务流程中。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">

<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">比起工具本身，我更在意它背后的趋势。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">开发方式正在发生变化：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">过去是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">人写代码，工具辅助</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">现在变成：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">人定义需求，AI 实现代码，人负责审查</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这对开发者的要求也在变化。</p>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">对学生来说</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果还在学习阶段，需要注意：</p>

<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AI 不太可能直接替代程序员，但会带来筛选。</p>

<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">六、和现有工具的区别</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">简单对比一下目前常见的几种工具：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">Copilot：主要是代码补全</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">Cursor：在 IDE 里增强 AI 能力</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">AIR：直接围绕 AI 构建开发流程</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">区别在于，AIR 更像是把“写代码”这件事整体交给 AI。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">七、几个现实问题</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">1. 代码质量能保证吗？</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">不一定。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">但 AIR 强制审查，这一点是加分项。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">2. 适合新手吗？</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">短期来看不太适合。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">因为如果你本身判断不了代码对不对，很难有效使用这种工具。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 2px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: flex; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(89, 89, 89, 1); border-top: 2px solid rgba(34, 34, 34, 1); line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 4px 6px 0; align-items: unset; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box unset; border-bottom: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-left: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-right: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">3. 会不会替代程序员？</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">更可能是改变工作方式，而不是直接替代。</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">八、聊聊你的看法</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">现在比较现实的问题是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">大部分人还没法真正体验 AIR。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果你已经用过（比如有 Mac）：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">可以分享一下：</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">实际好不好用</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">和 Cursor、Copilot 比差在哪</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal">有没有踩坑</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">如果你还没用：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">你会因为这种工具去换 Mac 吗？</p>
<hr data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: 1px">
<h2 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(251, 251, 251, 1); margin: 30px 0 15px; align-items: unset; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; display: block; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; line-height: 1.5em; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; padding: 0; position: relative; text-align: left; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(33, 33, 34, 1); line-height: 2.4em; letter-spacing: 0; padding: 0 30px 0 15px; border: 1px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-radius: 0 0 40px; align-items: unset; box-shadow: none; display: inline-block; font-weight: bold; flex-direction: unset; float: unset; height: auto; justify-content: unset; margin: 0; overflow-x: unset; overflow-y: unset; position: relative; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; text-shadow: none; transform: none; width: auto; -webkit-box-reflect: unset">九、总结</span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h2>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">AIR 的意义不在于“又多了一个 AI 工具”，而在于它尝试改变开发流程本身。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">以后写代码，可能不只是写，而是：</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">定义问题、引导 AI、审查结果。</p>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">这件事现在还在早期，但方向已经很明确了。</p>
</section>
